svg.title: Notation Meaning and convention X, Y, KYM(Y ) Native admitted support, literal preparation, and raw realized sector. Physical data occur in the third object, not in the source signature. π, σ, ι A readout and its specified sections. The finite frame section is σ(U) = (1, U). Other sections are named for their actual domains; none is a global inverse of every readout. G ⊆U(m), g The given closed matrix group in its faithful representation, its matrix size m, and its simple nonabelian real Lie algebra. The hypothesis does not add connectedness. Ue, Ae, rx Physical link, raw framed link and endpoint frame, Ue = r−1 x Aery for e : x →y. A reversed link is read by inversion. N, p, i Mesh cutoffindex, period index and scale level. The full N →∞limit is taken first at each suitable fixed p; the outer period limit may use the stated common refinement. hN, Lp, dN Physical mesh hN = d−1 N , physical integer period Lp and positive denom- inator dN. The lattice side is LpdN. ai, Li, ti Scale spacing, block ratio Li = ai/ai+1 and logarithmic scale ti = log(a−1 i ). Some retained calendar passages call this last clock τi; it is the same scale clock there. Li is not the physical period Lp. βN,p,i, bβi Actual calibrated action coefficient and reference clock bβi = ̄β + sti. Their difference is estimated, not set to zero. s, b0, CA The computed logarithmic slope s = 2b0 = 11CA/(24π2). Later occur- rences of s as a positive radius are local scale variables, not this slope.
